data.leadership_messages: 1. The IIR#2 Execution Review was conducted on 15 July 2026. On 16 July, the team identified a critical gap in the required task documentation. Although a continuous search and retrieval effort was maintained from 17 July through 3 August, ongoing document updates by external stakeholders made assessing these shifting requirements highly challenging.2. CA includes 28 child tasks. 3. Based on the WBS descriptions of the child tasks, we are unable to ascertain whether any of the originally provided CA data provided by NG on 4/16/26 is integrated into this CA. Based on discussions with NG on 8/4/26, the data previously tracked by the SPO from April ’26 has either been deleted, reassigned, redistributed, or rolled into other WBS elements due to duplicability. For awareness, we have listed those CAs below:
data.rationale: Data sets constantly changing from day-to-day making it difficult to understand long-term scope impacts. The team can only conduct analysis based on the most current data. Would meet the requirements of IIR#2. Beyond that will be more challenging.

areas.text: This element contains the scope for the integration and testing of C&L configurations in the Command and Launch (C&L) System Integration Lab (CSIL) in support of the INC 1, 2, and 3 test campaigns. It contains the work needed in order to effectively plan, develop test plans and procedures, execute test, and generate test reports for relevant integration and testing at the KDC Node level. It contains the scope for discrete specialty test at the KDC Node level, and KDC site/node integration and sell-off activities.
NG is working toward integration into P6. Final determination can be assessed once full integration is completed. Until that point, the SPO must use currently available resources.
Product element applies solely to KDC elements.
